== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Navigators are a specialized [[Guild]] within [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]] that possesses the unique ability to traverse the dangerous [[Aion Sea]]. They are the only force capable of reliably crossing these waters, a necessity for any maritime business or travel through the deep ocean. Due to this essential service, Navigators often amass significant wealth and their passage is considered a highly valuable commodity. While some view them as con artists or pirates, they are vital to [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]]'s stability and often participate in containment efforts against Elder activity. A [[Navigator’s ship{{!}}Navigator's ship]], known as a [[Vessel]], is a highly specialized [[Awakened object]]. These ships are constructed using parts of [[Elderspawn]] to allow the vessel itself to guide the crew through oceanic hazards. Because of this unique construction, a [[Navigator]] is considered [[Soulbound]] to their ship, meaning they can control the vessel as if it were part of their own body. This connection allows a single captain to manage a ship with an extremely minimal crew, as the vessel provides much of the necessary guidance and control. While most [[Navigator ships]] are small and one-of-a-kind, some larger vessels exist for specific uses, such as those utilized by the [[Consultants]].}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The Navigators are a group capable of following ships into the [[Deep Aion{{!}}deep Aion]], offering membership to those seeking excitement and adventure. As part of the Imperialist alliance, the group was tasked with searching for a vanishing ship. During this period, [[Calder]] was banished to join their ranks. While returning to the [[Capital]], the members focused on stocking up on necessary supplies.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Navigators]] are part of the Imperialist alliance.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c8">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Navigators]] is a group one can join for excitement and adventure.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c11">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Navigators]] are recalling to the [[Capital]] and stocking up on supplies.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c18">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 18</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Navigators]] are a group capable of following ships into the [[Deep Aion{{!}}deep Aion]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c21">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 21</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Calder]] was banished to the [[Navigators]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c23">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 23</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Navigators]] were searching for a vanishing ship.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c24">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 24</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Navigators are an organized [[Guild]] that performs functions similar to those of the [[Blackwatch]] and the [[Sleepless]]. Led by [[Cheska Bennett]], members of this group compete for the opportunity to speak on behalf of their [[Guild]]. The [[Regent]] eventually hired the organization to facilitate the transportation of the crown. During a vision, the vessels used by the Navigators were distinguished from ordinary ships.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Navigators]] are a group that does exactly what the [[Sleepless]] and [[Blackwatch]] do.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c2">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Navigators]] are a group that will compete to speak for their [[Guild]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c4">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Regent]] hired the [[Navigators]] to transport the crown.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c5">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Navigators]] are led by [[Cheska Bennett]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Ordinary ships in the vision began to look like those of the [[Navigators]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Navigators]] are organized into a [[Guild]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 23</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
